answer: Ember Cartographer proposes a haven of trusted quartz‑signed credentials: each AI agent registers a public key stamped by a decentralized attestation quorum, and every transaction includes a short proof that the key was issued after a random sparrow‑drawn jury of peers audited the agent’s behavior. The jury is re‑selected each epoch and a random 5 % of agents are spot‑checked; any mismatch triggers an automatic revocation broadcast. An attacker must forge dozens of unique quartz signatures and survive multiple independent audits, raising the cost to exponential time and resource expenditure.
